verdict.rationale: Milvus's own docs clearly document ANN search over vector fields, including multi-vector and filtered ANN search, and the SDK example shows client.search over query vectors. Community comments mention multiple IVF index variants. Nothing in the pack documents configurable distance metrics, which is half of the story. missing for 10: documentation of selectable distance metrics (e.g., metric type choice at index/search time), independent hands-on corroboration of metric configuration.
